      select id from retrieved_records where project_id = $1::uuid
    ), strong_page_ids as materialized (
      
    select left_record_id, right_record_id from (
      
    select a.id as left_record_id, candidate.id as right_record_id
    from left_record_ids left_id
    join retrieved_records a on a.project_id = $2::uuid and a.id = left_id.id and a.id >= $3::uuid
    cross join lateral (
      select b.id
      from retrieved_records b
      where b.project_id = $4::uuid
        and a.id < b.id
        and 
    a.doi is not null and b.doi is not null
    and btrim(a.doi) <> '' and btrim(b.doi) <> ''
    and btrim(lower(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(btrim(a.doi), '^https?://(dx\.)?doi\.org/', '', 'i'), '^doi:[[:space:]]*', '', 'i'))) = btrim(lower(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(btrim(b.doi), '^https?://(dx\.)?doi\.org/', '', 'i'), '^doi:[[:space:]]*', '', 'i')))
  
        
        and (a.id, b.id) > ($5::uuid, $6::uuid)
        and not exists (
    select 1 from retrieved_record_deduplication_decisions d
    where d.project_id = $7::uuid
      and d.left_retrieved_record_id = a.id
      and d.right_retrieved_record_id = b.id
  )
      order by b.id asc
      limit $8
    ) candidate
    where true
  
      union
      
    select a.id as left_record_id, candidate.id as right_record_id
    from left_record_ids left_id
    join retrieved_records a on a.project_id = $9::uuid and a.id = left_id.id and a.id >= $10::uuid
    cross join lateral (
      select b.id
      from retrieved_records b
      where b.project_id = $11::uuid
        and a.id < b.id
        and 
    a.source_record_id is not null and b.source_record_id is not null
    and btrim(a.source_record_id) <> '' and btrim(b.source_record_id) <> ''
    and a.search_source_id = b.search_source_id
    and a.source_record_id = b.source_record_id
  
        
        and (a.id, b.id) > ($12::uuid, $13::uuid)
        and not exists (
    select 1 from retrieved_record_deduplication_decisions d
    where d.project_id = $14::uuid
      and d.left_retrieved_record_id = a.id
      and d.right_retrieved_record_id = b.id
  )
      order by b.id asc
      limit $15
    ) candidate
    where true
  
    ) strong_signal_pairs
    order by left_record_id, right_record_id
    limit $16
  
    ), possible_signal_ids as (
      
    select a.id as left_record_id, candidate.id as right_record_id
    from left_record_ids left_id
    join retrieved_records a on a.project_id = $17::uuid and a.id = left_id.id 
    cross join lateral (
      select b.id
      from retrieved_records b
      where b.project_id = $18::uuid
        and a.id < b.id
        and 
    a.publication_year is not null
    and b.publication_year = a.publication_year
    and lower(regexp_replace(btrim(a.title), '[[:space:]]+', ' ', 'g'))
      = lower(regexp_replace(btrim(b.title), '[[:space:]]+', ' ', 'g'))
  
        and not (coalesce((
    a.doi is not null and b.doi is not null
    and btrim(a.doi) <> '' and btrim(b.doi) <> ''
    and btrim(lower(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(btrim(a.doi), '^https?://(dx\.)?doi\.org/', '', 'i'), '^doi:[[:space:]]*', '', 'i'))) = btrim(lower(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(btrim(b.doi), '^https?://(dx\.)?doi\.org/', '', 'i'), '^doi:[[:space:]]*', '', 'i')))
  ) or (
    a.source_record_id is not null and b.source_record_id is not null
    and btrim(a.source_record_id) <> '' and btrim(b.source_record_id) <> ''
    and a.search_source_id = b.search_source_id
    and a.source_record_id = b.source_record_id
  ), false))
        
        and not exists (
    select 1 from retrieved_record_deduplication_decisions d
    where d.project_id = $19::uuid
      and d.left_retrieved_record_id = a.id
      and d.right_retrieved_record_id = b.id
  )
      order by b.id asc
      limit $20
    ) candidate
    where true
  
    ), possible_page_ids as materialized (
      select distinct left_record_id, right_record_id from possible_signal_ids
      where (select count(*) from strong_page_ids) < $21
      order by left_record_id, right_record_id
      limit $22
    ), probe_ids as (
      select 0::int as strength_rank, left_record_id, right_record_id from strong_page_ids
      union all
      select 1::int, left_record_id, right_record_id from possible_page_ids
    ), ordered_probe as materialized (
      select strength_rank, left_record_id, right_record_id
      from probe_ids order by strength_rank, left_record_id, right_record_id limit $23
    ), visible_pairs as materialized (
      select strength_rank, left_record_id, right_record_id
      from ordered_probe order by strength_rank, left_record_id, right_record_id limit $24
    ), visible_record_ids as (
      select left_record_id as record_id from visible_pairs
      union
      select right_record_id as record_id from visible_pairs
    ), latest_match_state as (
      select distinct on (m.retrieved_record_id) m.retrieved_record_id, m.paper_id, m.action
      from retrieved_record_matches m
      join visible_record_ids v on v.record_id = m.retrieved_record_id
      where m.project_id = $25::uuid
      order by m.retrieved_record_id, m.sequence desc, m.id desc
    ), hydrated as (
      select p.strength_rank, p.left_record_id, p.right_record_id,
        jsonb_build_object(
          'leftRetrievedRecord', jsonb_build_object(
            'id', a.id::text, 'title', case when a.title is null then null when char_length(a.title) > $26 then left(a.title, $27) || '…' else a.title end, 'authors', (select case when char_length(value) > 230 then left(value, 229) || '…' else value end from (select array_to_string(a.authors[1:3], ', ') as value) author_preview),
            'publicationYear', a.publication_year, 'doi', case when a.doi is null then null when char_length(a.doi) > $28 then left(a.doi, $29) || '…' else a.doi end,
            'sourceRecordId', case when a.source_record_id is null then null when char_length(a.source_record_id) > $30 then left(a.source_record_id, $31) || '…' else a.source_record_id end,
            'currentPaperId', case when lm.action='linked' then lm.paper_id::text else null end,
            'mappingStatus', coalesce(lm.action, 'unmapped')
          ),
          'rightRetrievedRecord', jsonb_build_object(
            'id', b.id::text, 'title', case when b.title is null then null when char_length(b.title) > $32 then left(b.title, $33) || '…' else b.title end, 'authors', (select case when char_length(value) > 230 then left(value, 229) || '…' else value end from (select array_to_string(b.authors[1:3], ', ') as value) author_preview),
            'publicationYear', b.publication_year, 'doi', case when b.doi is null then null when char_length(b.doi) > $34 then left(b.doi, $35) || '…' else b.doi end,
            'sourceRecordId', case when b.source_record_id is null then null when char_length(b.source_record_id) > $36 then left(b.source_record_id, $37) || '…' else b.source_record_id end,
            'currentPaperId', case when rm.action='linked' then rm.paper_id::text else null end,
            'mappingStatus', coalesce(rm.action, 'unmapped')
          ),
          'reasons', array_remove(array[
            case when 
    a.doi is not null and b.doi is not null
    and btrim(a.doi) <> '' and btrim(b.doi) <> ''
    and btrim(lower(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(btrim(a.doi), '^https?://(dx\.)?doi\.org/', '', 'i'), '^doi:[[:space:]]*', '', 'i'))) = btrim(lower(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(btrim(b.doi), '^https?://(dx\.)?doi\.org/', '', 'i'), '^doi:[[:space:]]*', '', 'i')))
   then 'normalized_doi'::text end,
            case when 
    a.source_record_id is not null and b.source_record_id is not null
    and btrim(a.source_record_id) <> '' and btrim(b.source_record_id) <> ''
    and a.search_source_id = b.search_source_id
    and a.source_record_id = b.source_record_id
   then 'same_source_record_id'::text end,
            case when 
    a.publication_year is not null
    and b.publication_year = a.publication_year
    and lower(regexp_replace(btrim(a.title), '[[:space:]]+', ' ', 'g'))
      = lower(regexp_replace(btrim(b.title), '[[:space:]]+', ' ', 'g'))
   then 'normalized_title_year'::text end
          ], null::text),
          'strength', case when p.strength_rank=0 then 'strong' else 'possible' end
        ) as item
      from visible_pairs p
      join retrieved_records a on a.project_id = $38::uuid and a.id = p.left_record_id
      join retrieved_records b on b.project_id = $39::uuid and b.id = p.right_record_id
      left join latest_match_state lm on lm.retrieved_record_id = a.id
      left join latest_match_state rm on rm.retrieved_record_id = b.id
    )
    select coalesce((select jsonb_agg(item order by strength_rank, left_record_id, right_record_id) from hydrated), '[]'::jsonb) as items,
      (select count(*) > $40 from ordered_probe) as has_more

select id::text, sequence::text as sequence, decision,
      case when note is null then null when char_length(note) > 600 then left(note, 599) || '…' else note end as note_preview,
      coalesce(char_length(note) > 600, false) as note_truncated,
      created_at
    from retrieved_record_deduplication_decisions
    where project_id = $1::uuid
      and left_retrieved_record_id = $2::uuid
      and right_retrieved_record_id = $3::uuid
      
    order by sequence asc, id asc
    limit $4

bounded_reads.databaseWorkClaim: Pair identity probes retain top-K rows per left record and signal before deduplication/page truncation. PostgreSQL still evaluates candidate predicates across the relevant candidate universe; work is output-sensitive and can be quadratic for dense projects.

scope.implementationSql: The queue and history EXPLAIN cases use exported SQL builders called by the application readers.
scope.selectCounts: The bounded queue/history service calls are instrumented; transaction-control statements are reported separately from SELECT counts.

denseDoi1k.interpretation: PostgreSQL evaluates the dense DOI candidate search and sorts each left-record candidate set before its local top-K limit. The branch emits 25,649 deduplicated IDs, then 26 strong probe IDs and 25 visible pairs; the plan has no globally materialized full-M pair CTE or global M-pair sort before K, and rich record hydration follows the visible-pair boundary. Database candidate evaluation remains output-sensitive and can approach M in a dense fixture; this is not an O(P) work claim.

planInterpretation.boundedQueue: The 10k and 50k sparse EXPLAIN plans each return 26 queue probe IDs before the visible boundary, hydrate 25 pairs, use two SELECTs, and have no temporary spill. Complete node plans below record actual rows/loops, indexes, sort methods, buffers, and temporary I/O.
